snippet.title: The Last Gas Station: Winter Resort | Out Now
snippet.description:
Buy now on Steam: https://s.team/a/5374070

Return to the old gas station years later, this time as a raccoon. Turn the snowbound backwoods into a winter resort with an ice rink, ski slopes, guided tours, and cozy cabins for your guests.

Follow The Last Gas Station on X: https://x.com/playTLGS
